questions.stem: How does a simple respirometer measure the rate of respiration?

options.text: By measuring the amount of glucose used
By tracking the movement of a liquid as oxygen is consumed
By weighing the organisms before and after

questions.explanation: A respirometer measures oxygen uptake. As organisms use oxygen, the gas volume decreases (CO2 is absorbed by soda lime), causing a coloured liquid to move along a capillary tube.
